repos.title: Agentic Ops Hub
repos.subtitle: The control plane for the L0-L7 agentic income ecosystem.
repos.role: Keeps agent rules, MCP strategy, protection layers, and the full estate map aligned.
repos.primaryPath: Design the operating contract -> sync agents -> verify the release path.
repos.proofGate: Every repo gets visual provenance, deterministic text, and build/deploy checks.

repos.title: Starlight Agent Skills
repos.subtitle: Portable substrate skills for Starlight work.
repos.role: Turns the income thesis, affiliate loop, payment mandate, and queen coordination into portable skills.
repos.primaryPath: Package repeatable behavior -> document triggers -> ship skills into agents.
repos.proofGate: Skills stay small, named, and backed by source repo workflows.

repos.title: Agentic Income
repos.subtitle: The flagship hub for honest AI-agent income systems.
repos.role: Ranks for high-intent searches, tells the truth, and routes only to tools that genuinely win.
repos.primaryPath: Research demand -> publish comparisons -> bind affiliate catalog -> capture email.
repos.proofGate: Affiliate links are audited, JSON-LD is hardened, and build output is static-safe.

repos.title: Agentic Income Template
repos.subtitle: Clone-and-deploy starter for honest AI-tool comparison sites.
repos.role: Packages the hub method into a reusable site engine.
repos.primaryPath: Fork the template -> swap site config -> write comparisons -> deploy.
repos.proofGate: Portable affiliate audit and static OG surfaces ship with the template.

repos.title: Agentic Income Skills
repos.subtitle: Portable operating brain for income systems.
repos.role: Extracts the income thesis and affiliate audit loop into standalone skills.
repos.primaryPath: Explain the thesis -> choose programs honestly -> audit every recommendation.
repos.proofGate: Skills encode the no-hype, best-tool-wins rule.

repos.title: Awesome Agentic Income
repos.subtitle: Curated map of honest agentic income systems.
repos.role: Separates useful recurring-income resources from generic affiliate noise.
repos.primaryPath: Find source-grounded resources -> sort by usefulness -> keep the list current.
repos.proofGate: Public curation favors proof, recency, and editorial selectivity.

repos.title: Agentic Passive Income
repos.subtitle: Spoke site for set-and-review income loops.
repos.role: Uses the shared engine with a passive-income angle for builders who want set-and-review systems.
repos.primaryPath: Adapt the hub -> focus passive loops -> reuse catalog -> cross-link authority.
repos.proofGate: The spoke keeps the same audit discipline as the flagship hub.

repos.title: Payment Intelligence System
repos.subtitle: Fail-closed payments governance MCP.
repos.role: Verifies mandates, checks caps, records audit entries, and requires humans without moving money.
repos.primaryPath: Verify mandate -> check cap -> record audit -> require approval.
repos.proofGate: The MCP exposes verify-only tools and fails closed under invalid input.

repos.title: Awesome Payment Agent Skills
repos.subtitle: Curated payment protocols and safety tooling.
repos.role: Maps authorization, settlement, and audit tooling so agents can pay only under guardrails.
repos.primaryPath: Collect protocols -> classify risk -> link safety patterns -> update the map.
repos.proofGate: Curation favors protocols with clear authorization and audit semantics.

repos.title: Starlight Swarm
repos.subtitle: Queen-worker runtime for governed income streams.
repos.role: Models founder, queens, workers, and escalation with verify-only payments integration.
repos.primaryPath: Founder intent -> queen plan -> worker tasks -> escalation when risk rises.
repos.proofGate: Escalation spine and payments adapter are unit-tested.

repos.title: Starlight Evals
repos.subtitle: Whole-system evals and income/payments red-blue lane.
repos.role: Records receipts, named weaknesses, and red-blue probes before the stack touches real funds.
repos.primaryPath: Run probes -> collect receipts -> score risk -> gate release.
repos.proofGate: R4/R5/R6 lanes prove income and payments defenses before promotion.
